about.what: Every Ask setting tried, scored on the tuning half and on the held-out half of the test questions. A setting is chosen on the tuning half only.
about.rule: Most tuning questions right first, then most in the first three, then the fewest changes from the earlier setting.
about.hit: A question is a hit at 1 when the first passage shown comes from one of its investigations, at 3 when one of the first three does.
about.labelled_by: Claude (Anthropic), from the PSI records. To be checked by a team member.

split.method: mulberry32 shuffle of the everyday-word questions, then of the others, dealt alternately to the tuning and the held-out half

about.glossary: on the word match, for every setting
about.built_by: scripts/tune_ask.mjs (written with AI assistance: Claude Code, Anthropic)
